name: Power of Blessing
descriptionTemplate: Celeste gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Gain 1 Tentacle, Celeste's HP Recovery +15%, and when recovering HP, Temporary {Tentacle DMG} +[TentaclePower:Arg2].
lore:
They first called her a saint and bound her to the mast; later, they called her worthless and threw her into a cage.
It seemed they forgot that she could not determine life or death, only steer the ship's course.

patch.descriptionTemplate: Celeste gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Gain 1 Tentacle. Celeste's Healing +15%. When healing, Temporary {Tentacle DMG} +[TentaclePower:Arg2]. When triggers resurrect of {Undying Bird of Paradise}, Temporary {Tentacle DMG} +[TentaclePower:Arg3], with the effect doubled in Boss Battles.
